DECLARE
  l1 CLOB;
  l2 BLOB;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "HR"."DOCS" ("ID", "BODY", "IMG", "NOTE") VALUES (7, EMPTY_CLOB(), EMPTY_BLOB(), 'it''s') RETURNING "BODY", "IMG" INTO l1, l2;
  DBMS_LOB.APPEND(l1, …) × 254
END;
/

  l1 CLOB;
BEGIN

  DBMS_LOB.APPEND(l1, …) × 254
END;

  DBMS_LOB.WRITEAPPEND(l2, …) × 80
END;
